title: Zesty Silky American Fish Burger
description: A pescatarian-friendly American dish featuring silky fish patties, served on potato buns with a zesty twist, perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Soak the kombu sheets in cold water for 30 minutes to create the cold extract.
Drain and discard the kombu, reserving the extract for later use.
Cut the cod fillets into small pieces and pulse in a food processor until coarsely chopped.
Mix the chopped cod with 2 tablespoons of the reserved kombu extract, mayonnaise, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Divide the cod mixture into 4 equal parts and shape each part into a patty.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and cook the patties for 4 minutes per side, until cooked through.
Toast the potato buns by grilling them lightly on the skillet.
Assemble the burgers by spreading a layer of mayonnaise on the bottom bun, followed by a fish patty, a few slices of red onion, some shredded lettuce, diced tomato, and finally the top bun.
